changes.change: The fingers string had 'x' for the muted strings ('xx3211'); an 'x' is not a finger, so they are 0 (no finger).
Restored seven guitar slash chords (A/G#, Am/G#, E/D#, E/G#, Em/D#, Em/G#, F/D#) whose files existed upstream but were never imported, so upstream's build never contained them.
Declared the barres the fingerings already implied: one finger covers two or more strings on the same fret, but that fret was missing from barres.

Marked rootless: on ukulele, every voicing of the extended chords leaves out the root on purpose (four strings cannot hold five- to seven-note chords), so these are flagged `rootless: true` rather than treated as missing their root.
Relabelled from alt to b5 (major flat five: 1, 3, ♭5). These voicings have no ♭7, so they are not altered dominants.
Relabelled from 9#11 to 7#11: these voicings have no 9th.
Relabelled from m9 over the ♭7 (e.g. Cm9/B♭) to 7sus2 over the ♭7: these voicings contain 1, 5, ♭7 and 9 but no minor third.
Removed the ukulele 13b5b9 voicings: all four shapes in every key sound only ♭9, ♭5, 13 and ♭7, with neither root nor 3rd, which is not a complete 13b5b9 or any other chord in the table.
Marked rootless: a guitar voicing of a ninth chord that leaves out the root on purpose (e.g. Fmaj9 xx2213, which sounds as Am7), as jazz voicings often do.
Removed the finger on the muted low E string (fingers were shifted by one string).
The D string was fretted at 7, under the barre at 8; it is 9, the standard C9 barre shape.
The B string was at 4 (E♭, not in Dmaj9); at 5 it is the 9th.
The whole shape was one fret too high (it spelled a different chord); moved down a fret.
This was a copy of Am7 position 3 (5x555x); transposed up a fret to B♭m7.
Muted the open high E string, which is not in Baug.
Muted the open low E string, which is not in D7♯9.
Muted the open low E string, which is not in E♭11.
Muted the open high E string, which is not in Dm(maj7).
Muted the high E string (B♭, the natural 5th, which a ♭5 chord replaces).
Muted the high E string (B♭, the natural 5th, which a ♭5 chord replaces) and dropped the barre at 6 that no finger played.
This was a copy of Fmadd9 position 1 (xx3113); transposed down a fret to Emadd9.
This was a copy of Fmadd9 position 2 (x8658x); transposed down a fret to Emadd9.
This was a copy of Amadd9 position 1 (2002); transposed up two frets to Bmadd9.
This was a copy of Amadd9 position 2 (5452); transposed up two frets to Bmadd9.
This was a copy of Amadd9 position 3 (4453); transposed up two frets to Bmadd9.
This was a copy of E11 position 1 (1220); transposed up a fret to F11 (rootless, like the other ukulele 11ths).
Relabelled from C9 to Cadd9: it has no ♭7. Also uncrossed its fingers (2 on fret 3, 1 on fret 2).
Relabelled from Dm(maj11) to Dadd11: it has a major 3rd and no 7th.
Relabelled from Gm11 to Gmaj11: it has a major 3rd and a major 7th.
Relabelled from C♯11 to C♯7♯11: it has a ♯11 (G), not an 11th.
Muted the high E string (C♯, the natural 5th) and relabelled from alt to b5 like the rest of the alt family (#6); dropped the unplayed barre.
Removed: A copy of Fmadd9 position 3 that does not transpose to E (it relies on the open G string).
Removed: A copy of Fmadd9 position 4 that does not transpose to E (it relies on the open G string).
Removed: A copy of C♯7sus4 position 1, filed under C♯aug.
Removed: A copy of C♯7sus4 position 2, filed under C♯aug.
Removed: A copy of a C♯9♯11 voicing (now C♯7♯11), filed under C♯11.
Removed: A copy of C♯9♯11 position 3, filed under C♯11.
Removed: A copy of a C♯9♯11 voicing (now C♯7♯11), filed under C♯11.
Removed: A copy of Em/C position 2 (x32003), filed under C♯9♯11.
Removed: Identical to G major position 1.
Removed: Sounds A, C, B and D, which is no form of Adim, and no nearby correction makes one.
Removed: Sounds E, A, A♭, D, G and C, which is no form of A♭maj7♭5; no nearby correction makes one.
Removed: Sounds F, A, C and G♯, which is no form of Gadd9; no nearby correction makes one.
Removed: Sounds E♭, G♭, C, F, A♭ and C♯, which is no form of E♭m6/9; no nearby correction makes one.
Added C♯11 voicings, transposed up a fret from C11 positions 1, 2 and 4, after removing the copied ones (all shapes also match D11 transposed down).
Removed the fingers marked on muted strings under the barre; muted strings take no finger.
Every string is open or muted, so no fingers; the fingers belonged to a different shape.
Removed a declared barre that no finger plays (each note on that fret has its own finger).

Refingered: the fingering was impossible (a fretted string with no finger, a finger on two frets, crossed fingers, or a barre over lower notes). The frets are unchanged; the fingers are the plainest playable assignment (lowest fret first, a barre where one finger covers a whole fret).
Only the A string had been moved up from the A6 shape (xcbbax), giving xdbbax; the whole shape moved up a fret is xdccbx, B♭6.

Muted the lowest string: it sounded a chord tone other than the root, and the next string up plays the root, so the chord now has its root in the bass (e.g. Bm 224432 -> x24432). Inversions that cannot be fixed this way are kept, with a notes/inverted-bass warning. Where the root-position version already exists as its own voicing, the inversion is kept as an alternative.
Added D7/F# (200212), as proposed upstream.

Regenerated every piano voicing from the cited formulas in data/qualities.json (root position, notes spelled by letter, with octaves), replacing data from a source with no known license. This fixes inconsistent spellings (E♭m was D# F# A#), gives each note an octave (C13's 9th now sits above its 7th), corrects degree labels (Cdim7's ♭♭7 was labelled 6), uses the same suffix spelling as the other instruments (minor, 7#9), and adds the qualities piano lacked, including m13.

Reordered every chord's voicings easiest first, by the playability score in src/playability.ts, so the first voicing is the one a player reaches for (e.g. C major starts with x32010). Voicing ids are unchanged.
Muted the two lowest strings: neither sounded the root and the third string up does, so the chord now has its root in the bass (e.g. A11 777789 -> xx7789).

The barre crossed a muted string, which it would have sounded. The lowest string, cut off from the rest by the muted strings, is now fretted with the thumb (T), and the barre covers only the strings above the mute, as shapes like D/F# 2xx232 are played.

The barre crossed a muted string, which it would have sounded. Refingered with the playable fingering closest to the original: a second finger or a partial barre takes the note beyond the mute, and the thumb is used on the low E only where no finger is free.

Put the root in the bass by fretting it on the lowest string (or on a muted string below), keeping every other note of the voicing; fingers adjusted to match (e.g. A♭dim7 xx0101 -> 4x0101, Dm x8776x -> x5776x).

Put the root in the bass with a two-string edit: the root is added on a lower string and one note moves or is muted so the shape stays within the hand's span (e.g. A♭m xx9897 -> xx68x7, F6/9 x55565 -> x85765).
Put the root in the bass with a three-string edit in the same neck position (e.g. A♭m(maj7)♭5 abcccx -> xbccca, the mirrored shape with the root on the A string).
Removed an inversion (its lowest note is not the root) that the database already has: The same inversion (A♭m9 with C♭ in the bass) is already covered by A♭m9/B.
Removed an inversion (its lowest note is not the root) that the database already has: The same inversion (Bm9 with D in the bass) is already covered by Bm9/D.
Removed an inversion (its lowest note is not the root) that the database already has: Identical to Dm9/F position 1, where this inversion belongs.
